text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning. A massive pile of cardboard boxes
was stacked in front of the student dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Supplies meant to be delivered to the academy
had been mistakenly brought here instead.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaa~!
I've never seen so many packages before!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: With this many, my arms are raring to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had she spoken than Winning Ticket
tried to scoop up the cardboard boxes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Ticket.
You don't seriously intend to carry all those boxes, do you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yup! For us, stuff like this is light as a feather!
Easy peasy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No... it's impossible. I just did a quick calculation, and we won't make it in time before classes start.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a race with a time limit!
Now I'm totally fired upppp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket dashed off carrying the boxes, and then...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm back!
Lap 2, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That was 5.8 seconds faster than my estimate.
Do you intend to surpass your limits, Ticket?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Surpass, surpass! Next time I'll surpass them even moreee!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Fascinating.
Let us see if I, too, can surpass my limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just Biwa Hayahide, but other horse girls
began helping to carry boxes one after another.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO!
I'm not gonna loseeeee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With crowds of horse girls running back and forth between the dorm and school,
the pile visibly dwindled in no time.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I brought the very last package!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was great morning exercise!
Though I'm not sure who came in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What is certain... is that each and every one of us
has broken past our previous limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Winning Ticket and the others giving it their all,
the trouble was swiftly resolved.
